projects.name: fearcurve
projects.pitch: Market-implied probability distributions from option prices (Breeden-Litzenberger), validated against Black-Scholes.
projects.headline: Validated against the analytic Black-Scholes case.

projects.name: fluke
projects.pitch: Is your best backtest real? Probability of Backtest Overfitting (CSCV) and Deflated Sharpe Ratio after López de Prado.
projects.headline: Probability of Backtest Overfitting (CSCV) and Deflated Sharpe Ratio.

projects.name: footnote
projects.pitch: Question answering over SEC 10-K filings with citations, and an XBRL-derived eval harness that measures how often it's right.
projects.headline: Cited answers over 10-K filings, scored against an XBRL-derived gold set.

projects.name: honest-odds
projects.pitch: Are prediction markets calibrated? Calibration, favourite-longshot bias and a strict out-of-sample check on 2,946 resolved Polymarket markets.
projects.headline: 2,946 resolved Polymarket markets, strict out-of-sample check.

projects.name: spike-and-gradient
projects.pitch: Linear regression, a Hodgkin-Huxley neuron and a neural network from first principles in NumPy, each verified against a trusted reference.
projects.headline: 97.8% on MNIST, every model verified against a reference.

projects.name: alpha-graveyard
projects.pitch: Automated trading-strategy discovery, and why most discoveries are fake: 15,000 candidates, 0 survive out of sample.
projects.headline: 15,000 candidate strategies, 0 survive the held-out decade.

projects.name: blind-committee
projects.pitch: LLM analyst agents, a risk manager and a portfolio manager, with a defence against lookahead through the model's training data. Evaluated honestly.
projects.headline: Does not beat equal weight, and says so.

projects.name: touchdown
projects.pitch: Vision-based drone landing: detect the pad, estimate pose, guide the descent. 86/100 simulated landings, median 9.9 cm, ~370 fps on a laptop CPU.
projects.headline: 86/100 simulated landings, median error 9.9 cm, ~370 fps on a laptop CPU.

projects.name: Apto

projects.headline: Live demo online.

projects.headline: In beta on TestFlight.

projects.name: Facility-service tooling

projects.headline: Running in production.

projects.name: FITFIT
